name: silos
description: Silos integration for Claude Code agents. A SessionStart hook writes a zero-token birth marker and injects the Silos briefing, the fleet roster and the agent's unread messages; a PreToolUse gate turns an agent's recurring native crons into Silos automations. Skills: shared tasks in the project's list (team-plan), the heartbeat turn (heartbeat), credentials through the Vault (vault-secrets), support case files (support-inbox) and writing a silo for the owner, submitted for approval (silo-author).
